note: Direct crates that `yolo update rust apply` must never move, with the reason. Exact `=x.y.z` pins in a manifest are not listed here: they are deliberate, reported as [exact pin] and only moved by an explicit `apply --majors <crate>`. Advisory-driven holds also belong in advisory-holds.json. Remove an entry as soon as its blocker moves; docs/operations/infra/update/RUST.md carries the long form.

companion of yara-x =1.7.0: yara-x's build script needs the matching 1.7.0 generation. A plain `cargo update` moves it to 1.21.0 (in range ^1.7.0), which breaks `cargo check -p aphrody-re --features yara` (ModuleOptions has no field rust_module). apply restores the lock pin.

companion of yara-x =1.7.0: yara-x's build script needs the matching 1.7.0 generation. A plain `cargo update` moves it to 1.21.0 (in range ^1.7.0), which breaks `cargo check -p aphrody-re --features yara` (ModuleOptions has no field rust_module). apply restores the lock pin. Pinning yara-x-macros makes cargo re-pick the syn/prettyplease pair of bindgen 0.73.2 (syn 2 with prettyplease 0.3, which does not compile); relock repairs it with `cargo update -p bindgen@0.73.2 --recursive`.
